purpose: Machine-readable disposition of every acceptance threshold proposed for a future parser-v3-v2 evaluation. This artifact records the audit outcome. It is not itself an acceptance criterion and the contract compiler does not read it.

binds_to.agreement_rule: For every threshold_id below, disposition and status must equal the corresponding fields in the policy's acceptance_thresholds.items. A test enforces this so the two artifacts cannot drift.
binds_to.schema_version_history: Bound to phase1-parser-v3-prospective-evaluation-policy/v2 while Phase 1.2F held the policy at REVIEW_REQUIRED. Rebound to /v3 in Phase 1.2G when the policy was finalized. The binding is checked by test against the loaded policy so the two cannot drift.

prohibited_basis_types: target-model task or headroom screening results
industry standard without a primary source and applicability analysis
textual substitution from the parser-v2 gate contract
selecting a number because it would likely permit a pass

gate_coverage_baseline.error_definition_note: Audit finding A2. A gate's maximum_errors is meaningless until the gate declares what one error is. The only registered definition of an S06 error is the narrow one in docs/phase1_parser_v3_acceptance_gates.json, namely selection of the registered rightmost distractor span. That gate therefore does not pin an S06 case to exact typed-decision agreement, and S06 belongs to the free population. The earlier 90/30 baseline was obtained only by reading the same field three incompatible ways.
gate_coverage_baseline.implication: Any criterion whose binding value lies at or below 80 of 120 is vacuous under the mandatory gates.

dispositions.controlled_risk: broad diffuse extraction failure across the set
dispositions.one_line_finding: Vacuous at or below 80 of 120; its binding range 81-120 is arithmetically identical to a budget on the free strata S04, S05, S06 and S09.

dispositions.controlled_risk: concentration of failures inside a single adversarial stratum
dispositions.one_line_finding: Inert on the critical strata that already carry zero-error gates (S07, S08, S10, S11); its only independent content is S04, S05, S06 and S09, which duplicates threshold 1.

dispositions.controlled_risk: claimed: systematic collapse of one presence class; already covered at zero tolerance by existing gates
dispositions.one_line_finding: Feasible range is 0.636895 to 1.0 so any threshold at or below 0.636895 is vacuous; and a parser with 40 wrong canonical values scores macro F1 exactly 1.0000 while failing 40 of 120 on exact typed decision.

dispositions.controlled_risk: claimed: silent regression against the deployed parser
dispositions.one_line_finding: No margin is choosable without observing a parser, and no comparator run exists to choose one from.

withdrawn_arguments.argument: The comparator itself failed its own locked evaluation, so it is not a fitness reference.
withdrawn_arguments.why: A predecessor's formal FAIL on its own holdout says nothing about whether per-case agreement with it is informative. The argument conflates the comparator's verdict with the comparator's usefulness as reported context.

withdrawn_arguments.argument: The comparator run does not exist.
withdrawn_arguments.why: True but not a reason the criterion is unsound. A future authorized run could supply it, so this is a statement about timing, not about the metric. The surviving reason is that no margin is derivable without observing a parser.

dispositions.controlled_risk: extraction failure in the four adversarial strata no zero-error gate covers
dispositions.one_line_finding: Structure derived candidate-independently from gate coverage; value fixed at zero by the finite-conformance-suite premise, under which every case admitted to the set carries a mandatory reference decision and no mismatch is a tolerable deviation.

confusion_matrix_analysis.method: exhaustive enumeration over all feasible confusion matrices
confusion_matrix_analysis.constraint: Under the mandatory gates every no_answer case and every ambiguous case is pinned correct, so the only presence errors possible are within the 40 present cases of S04, S05, S06 and S09.
confusion_matrix_analysis.enumeration_domain: All (errors_to_no_answer, errors_to_ambiguous) pairs of non-negative integers summing to at most 40, i.e. C(42,2) = 861 matrices.

spread_at_equal_error_counts.note: Audit finding A1. Every bound below is an attained extremum of the enumeration, not a rounded illustration. A test recomputes them.

presence_error_vs_value_error.finding: A present case with a wrong canonical value keeps presence class present. It is a true positive for presence and a failure for exact typed decision. Worst case: exact agreement 80 of 120 while answer-presence macro F1 is exactly 1.0000.

post_hoc_disclosure: This audit was performed after some parser-v3 development results were already known to the project. No numeric value was derived from, checked against, or tuned toward any observed parser behaviour. Phase 1.2F left the single surviving hard criterion unresolved rather than assigning it a defensible-sounding number; Phase 1.2G resolved it at zero on a LOGICAL_INVARIANT basis entailed by the conformance premise, which is a decision about what the set is and not an observation of any parser.

phase_1_2g_update.note: Phase 1.2F left residual_critical_exact_budget REVIEW_REQUIRED because the prior scientific question - how strict the instrument must be on designed-failure strata that no gate pins - had never been decided. Phase 1.2G decided it.
phase_1_2g_update.consequence: residual_critical_exact_budget is KEEP_HARD at 0 pooled and 0 per stratum, on the LOGICAL_INVARIANT basis. The accepted policy requires exact typed-decision agreement on all 120 registered cases.
phase_1_2g_update.unchanged: The four originally proposed thresholds keep their Phase 1.2F dispositions. Nothing in this update reopens them.
